title: Effect of time and storage temperature on canine and feline erythrocyte sedimentation rate
author: Gori, Pasquini, et al.

steps.title: Gather materials and instrument
steps.instruction: Obtain the MINI‑PET automated ESR device (DIESSE, Diagnostica Senese S.p.A.) and ensure it is set up according to the manufacturer’s instructions; verify that the instrument can hold up to four K3‑EDTA tubes simultaneously. Prepare 1 mL K3‑EDTA tubes (Ø 12 × 56 mm; APTACA Spa, Canelli, AT, Italy) and a tube rocker.

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Draw blood from the enrolled animals (40 dogs and 12 cats) into the 1 mL K3‑EDTA tubes, labeling each tube with animal ID, species, and collection time.

steps.title: Assign temperature groups
steps.instruction: Using random.org, randomly assign each sample to either the “room temperature” group or the “refrigerated” group, ensuring each group contains 20 dogs and 6 cats.

steps.title: Schedule ESR measurement times
steps.instruction: For the room‑temperature group, plan ESR measurements at T0 (within 20 min of sampling, immediately after CBC), and again at 2 h, 4 h, 6 h, and 8 h post‑collection. For the refrigerated group, plan measurements at T0 and at 24 h after collection (samples will be stored at 4‑6 °C for 24 h, then brought to room temperature for a few minutes before the 24 h reading).

steps.title: Prepare sample for ESR reading
steps.instruction: At each scheduled time point, place the blood tube on the tube rocker while waiting for analysis. Immediately before loading, gently invert the tube completely 10 times to mix the sample.

steps.title: Load sample into MINI‑PET
steps.instruction: Insert the mixed blood tube into one of the four available positions on the MINI‑PET instrument.

steps.title: Run ESR measurement
steps.instruction: On the instrument display, select the patient’s species, then start the 14‑minute countdown. After the 14‑minute optical reading, record the displayed ESR value (mm/h).

steps.title: Handle instrument errors
steps.instruction: If an “error” message appears, remove the tube, gently resuspend the blood by inverting 10 times, and repeat the measurement. If the error persists after the repeat attempt, exclude the sample from the study.

steps.title: Record data
steps.instruction: Log for each sample the animal ID, species, temperature condition, exact time point (T0, 2 h, 4 h, 6 h, 8 h, or 24 h), and the ESR result (mm/h) in a data sheet for later statistical analysis.
